interface.title: Nomad
interface.description: A concept for a travel app that puts the destination first. Instead of overwhelming users with options, the experience is designed to make discovering places feel simple, immersive, and enjoyable before booking.
interface.objective: The goal was to create a cleaner travel experience where beautiful visuals, intuitive navigation, and a focused booking flow work together to help users explore naturally.
interface.thinking: Designed around destination-first storytelling. Kept interactions simple to reduce decision fatigue. Used a dark interface to let photography become the focus. Created a smooth journey from discovery to booking.

preview.alt: Nomad travel app — Leh Ladakh three-screen interface mockup

interface.title: Health Karma
interface.description: A concept for a modern credit health app that makes financial information easier to understand through clear visualizations, AI assistance, and a simplified dashboard experience. The focus was on making complex financial data feel approachable instead of overwhelming.
interface.objective: The goal was to design an experience that helps users monitor, understand, and improve their credit health through intuitive insights, clean navigation, and actionable recommendations.
interface.thinking: Turned complex financial data into simple visual insights. Balanced data density with a clean, approachable interface. Introduced AI assistance to guide users through financial decisions. Designed a flexible dashboard that surfaces the most important information first.

preview.alt: Health Karma credit health app — four-screen mobile interface mockup

interface.title: Swaply
interface.description: A concept for a community-driven marketplace where people can exchange products instead of simply buying and selling. The focus was on making every interaction feel transparent, trustworthy, and easy to navigate.
interface.objective: The goal was to simplify the barter experience by helping users quickly evaluate listings, build trust with sellers, and confidently propose exchanges through a clean, intuitive interface.
interface.thinking: Designed a trust-first marketplace experience. Simplified product discovery and exchange decisions. Highlighted seller credibility through ratings and activity. Created a clear and frictionless barter flow from browsing to proposal.

preview.alt: Swaply barter marketplace — product detail and seller profile mobile mockups

motion.title: Contextual Chat Motion Study
motion.description: Micro-interactions for AI response states—typing indicators, result reveal, and smooth panel transitions during discovery.
motion.objective: Communicate system intelligence through motion timing, not decoration—calm, premium, and legible.
motion.thinking: Easing curves tuned for readability. Staggered result cards reinforce scan order. Motion pauses on reduced-motion preference.

motion.title: Systematic Agent Interaction
motion.description: End-to-end interaction demo showing query input, AI processing, and contextual result expansion in a single fluid sequence.
motion.objective: Demonstrate how motion supports comprehension in AI workflows—never competing with the content layer.
motion.thinking: Each transition maps to a system state change. Duration scaled to cognitive load: faster for confirmations, slower for new information.

motion.title: Investor Workflow Friction Map
motion.description: Animated visualization of fragmented investor search—highlighting friction points that motivated the conversational redesign.
motion.objective: Use motion to tell a problem story quickly for stakeholders before diving into solution screens.
motion.thinking: Looping GIF with restrained palette. Motion draws attention to drop-off moments without flashy transitions.
